question: Why do multi-agent LLM systems converge on a hub-and-spoke (orchestrator + subagents) topology rather than a mesh of peer agents?
summary: Independently derived O(N^2) vs O(N) coordination cost, single-state-owner/arbiter for stochastic conflicts, permission choke point, and local failure containment as the drivers of hub-and-spoke dominance; corpus confirms all of these plus names hub-as-single-point-of-failure as an explicit trade-off not surfaced in the first-principles pass.
